review.notes: Full review. All 13 sampled targets (1.1-5.2) checked against the four sources read through the sources service (29 locators; the fetch recorded the four entries in the package's sources.toml). Every Check recomputed: matrix statements in exact rational arithmetic (including 300 random quadratic-termination runs, 200 least-change instances, 241 non-symmetric inverse instances), Newton and Kantorovich values by hand. 34 library declarations opened at the pins. Dependency check: 0 problems. Suggested.lean elaborates with sorry as the only warning; #check of all 24 declarations compared with the README; one-tactic probe closes none of the 13 theorems. The automatic checks all passed. One P2: a false sentence in the Layer 1 Examples (positive definite Hessian on a Hilbert space is not invertible in infinite dimensions). Not verifiable from the extraction: the inequality sign in Dennis-More 1977 Theorem 8.1 and three displayed equations.
